annotations.title: Fancy text for Discord, Twitch and bios

description: Convert plain text into Unicode "font" styles that paste anywhere fonts can't be changed: Discord and Twitch chat, usernames, bios, stream titles. Styles: bold (Bold), italic (Italic), bolditalic (Bold italic), sansbold (Sans bold), sansitalic (Sans italic), sansbolditalic (Sans bold italic), script (Script), boldscript (Bold script), fraktur (Gothic), boldfraktur (Bold gothic), double (Double-struck), mono (Monospace), smallcaps (Small caps), superscript (Tiny (superscript)), wide (Wide (aesthetic)), circled (Bubbles), negcircled (Dark bubbles), squared (Squares), negsquared (Dark squares), strike (Strikethrough), underline (Underline), slash (Slashed), upside (Upside down). Leave "style" empty to get every style at once. Screen readers read these characters poorly, so suggest plain text for important information.
name: style_text
